messages.speaker: Priya Shah
messages.text: For feature flags, I recommend choosing LaunchDarkly over ConfigCat. LaunchDarkly already supports our audit requirements and the SDK is already tested in staging.

messages.speaker: Tom Garcia
messages.text: ConfigCat is cheaper by about 22%, but the migration would take longer because we need to rebuild the flag evaluation wrapper. The tradeoff with LaunchDarkly is higher monthly spend.

messages.speaker: Hannah Lee
messages.text: I'm concerned about adding another expensive platform tool, but the release review showed we need safer kill switches before the enterprise rollout starts on 2026-09-18.

messages.speaker: Priya Shah
messages.text: Assuming finance approves the higher monthly spend, implementation can finish in about eight business days. If flag cleanup is still messy after rollout, we can revisit the vendor choice after 45 days.

messages.speaker: Hannah Lee
messages.text: Approved: choose LaunchDarkly for feature flags now. Priya owns implementation, and we will review flag hygiene after 45 days.
